summary: Iteration 101 — Binotel Analytics integration tested end-to-end. Wrote 13 new tests covering: /config, /mapping (GET+PUT+dedup+idempotency), /employees, /stats, /mapping/automap, /amocrm-users, /events/manager-stats binotelUsed flag, and in-process aggregation via monkeypatch on _fetch_period (verifies employeeID/billsec/disposition extraction, incoming/outgoing split, answerRate, avgTalkSec, mapping → amoCRM userId). All 13/13 passed. Regression suite from iteration_100 (7 tests on live call_analytics_calls overlay) also re-run and 7/7 passed. binotel_user_mapping collection cleaned before & after run.
critical_code_review_comments: binotel_analytics.py uses MappingItem.dict() — Pydantic V2 deprecates .dict() in favor of .model_dump(). Will keep working in Pydantic 2.x but emits warnings; consider migrating.
_fetch_period swallows ALL exceptions and returns [] — fine for resilience but masks misconfiguration. Consider surfacing a single warning counter for ops visibility.

automap endpoint: existing mapping is preserved for employees not seen in current period, but if an admin renames a Binotel employee, the stale binotelEmployeeName persists. Acceptable trade-off, just worth documenting.

aggregate_by_employee converts date_to via .replace(hour=23,...) only when hour & minute are both 0 — if a user passes '2026-01-31T01:00' it'll silently use 01:00 as upper bound which is probably surprising. Consider always extending to 23:59:59 unless explicit T-time provided with non-zero hour AND minute AND seconds.

_load_mapping returns ALL docs with str(amocrmUserId or '') — empty strings are kept in the mapping result dict but they're filtered out by aggregate_by_amocrm_user via `if not amo_uid: continue`. Works, but the dict could be slimmed at the source.

manager_events_analytics.py is 890 lines — already flagged in iteration_100 review; this iteration added ~50 lines of Binotel overlay code, pushing it further. Strongly consider splitting Binotel overlay logic into a helper module.

GET /binotel/employees raises HTTPException(400) when not configured but GET /binotel/stats returns {configured:false,...} for the same situation. Inconsistent — pick one pattern (the silent fallback is friendlier for the UI).
test_credentials: admin/admin123 — not used; binotel endpoints currently unauthenticated.
seed_data_creation: Transient: 2 docs in binotel_user_mapping during test_aggregate_by_amocrm_user_uses_mapping (cleaned in finally). PUT /mapping wrote 2 docs which are deleted by the module-scoped cleanup_mapping fixture after the run. Verified collection is empty post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest backend/tests/test_binotel_analytics_iteration101.py -v` to retest. The test file self-cleans binotel_user_mapping (module-scoped fixture) and uses monkeypatch for in-process aggregation tests so it doesn't require external Binotel API reachability. BINOTEL_API_KEY/SECRET present in backend/.env means /config returns configured:true and /employees doesn't 400 — but the real Binotel API is unreachable from preview, so _fetch_period yields []. To force the unconfigured branch in HTTP tests, temporarily unset the env vars and restart backend.
rca of the issue: N/A — this is a feature-addition iteration, not a bug fix. Verified that (a) configuration detection works via env vars, (b) mapping CRUD is idempotent and dedupes by binotelEmployeeId, (c) when Binotel is configured but returns 0 calls the overlay simply doesn't override snapshot values and binotelUsed=false, (d) automap and other endpoints return ≤4xx (never 5xx) even when downstream APIs are unreachable, (e) aggregation correctly splits incoming/outgoing, computes answerRate over total attempts, computes avgTalkSec over answered only, and respects the saved Binotel→amoCRM mapping.
